### SEAQUIP


Event Date : March 2, 2027 - March 4, 2027
Event Location : Fiera Milano Rho, Italy


Event Link :[https://www.seaquip.it/](https://www.seaquip.it/)


Twin Disc and Rolla will be attending SEAQUIP this coming March!


SEAQUIP brings the very best of international yachting to Milan, hosting a premier B2B exhibition dedicated to the nautical and marine equipment industry.


We are excited to be attending and hope to see you there.
